compiled_state.title: Implement providers/config.py with env-wins config validation (ConfigError vs AuthError)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
DD4: fail-loud config validation distinguishing ConfigError from AuthError

## Implementation
providers/config.py:
- ConfigError(Exception): raised when provider name absent or unknown
- AuthError(Exception): raised when valid provider has missing API key env var
- get_provider(name: str | None = None) -> Provider:
  1. Check CI_REVIEW_PROVIDER env var first (env wins)
  2. Fall back to dso-config.conf ci_review.provider key
  3. Raise ConfigError if neither set or if name is unknown
  4. Check API key env var (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY per provider)
  5. Raise AuthError if key missing
  6. Return provider instance

Known providers: {"anthropic": AnthropicProvider, "openai": OpenAIProvider}
(MockProvider is test-only, not in production routing)

Config file parsing: grep '^ci_review.provider=' .claude/dso-config.conf | cut -d= -f2-

.test-index: remove RED marker for config.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes (config tests GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] ruff check passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] ConfigError raised on unknown provider
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.providers.config import get_provider, ConfigError; import os; os.environ.pop('CI_REVIEW_PROVIDER',None); get_provider('unknown_xyz')" 2>&1 | grep -q ConfigError
- [ ] AuthError raised on missing API key
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.providers.config import get_provider, AuthError; import os; os.environ.pop('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY',None); os.environ['CI_REVIEW_PROVIDER']='anthropic'; get_provider()" 2>&1 | grep -q AuthError

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
